# Vendored map data (FINDER lane)

- `us-atlas-states-albers-10m.json`: us-atlas@3.0.1 `states-albers-10m.json`, fetched 2026-10-27
  from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/us-atlas@3.0.1/states-albers-10m.json. Licence: ISC (`us-atlas-LICENSE.txt`, copied from the package). The shapes
  derive from the U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files.
- `us-map.json`: generated by `tools/geo-build.mjs` from the file above (SVG path data for the lower-48 states and
  DC, viewBox 0 0 975 610) plus the projected store points from `../geo.json` (Nominatim / OpenStreetMap data,
  ODbL; geocoded once).
